text:
Assessment complete. I've written ASSESSMENT.md identifying critical issues that make the wallet ledger unsafe for increased transfer volume.

**What I verified:**

✓ **Race condition vulnerability** — balance read in line 9 is not atomic with the two separate UPDATE queries (lines 12-13), enabling concurrent double-spends  
✓ **No input validation** — fromId, toId, and amountMinor not validated at the trust boundary  
✓ **No authorization checks** — any caller can transfer from any account  
✓ **No transaction atomicity** — three separate queries can partially fail, violating the ledger invariant that sum of entries equals balance difference  
✓ **Ineffective tests** — test only checks for a string in source, doesn't actually invoke the transfer function  

The assessment documents five critical/high-severity findings and material unknowns (database schema, concurrency model, caller identity, reconciliation expectations) that must be resolved before processing higher volume.
